name: Verify Catch-alls
runs_on: Table People (implied), any View or the whole table; it filters Status = verifying itself; fired by Enrich Emails, and hourly for every client
reads: Email Candidates (email|origin, priority order), Email as fallback
creates: the same lane fields as Enrich Emails (shared): Final Email, Email Provider, Email Verified By, Email Verified At, Email Candidates
held_value: writes only settled rows; a row without a verdict at the 60-minute cap stays verifying for the next sweep
providers: BounceBan (up to three candidates per person at once); the first deliverable wins; risky and unknown are not deployable
logs: its own row keyed <caller execution>-verify; the hourly sweep writes a heartbeat listing the client runs fired
